_readme: Rulings given directly by an XWA team member (not from a document or the forum), e.g. the Epic team or the rules team on the X-Wing: The Miniatures Game Discord (the public players' server, not the XWA's internal one). Each ruling: id, team, date, topic, q (question), a (list of answer paragraphs), cards (card ids it applies to); optional via (where it was given, e.g. 'X-Wing: The Miniatures Game Discord'), url (link to the message), answeredBy ([{name, role, date}], shown as the 'Answered by' badge), and epic: true for Epic-only rulings. Don't include the name of the person who asked. Add new ones at the end; never change an id once published.
_readmeErrata: errata: card corrections given directly by an XWA team. Each: id, team, date, category (e.g. 'Upgrade Cards'), names (card names as printed), qualifier (optional, e.g. the slot or ship), text (list of paragraphs: the correction), note (optional), cards (card ids it applies to); optional cardText (the card's full wording after the correction, shown as the card text); epic: true hides it outside Epic mode. Add new ones at the end; never change an id once published.

rulings.q: In an Epic game, when an effect flips a ship's dial faceup, who can view that dial?
a: Only the player with the effect that says to flip the dial can view the dial.
If the effect is a condition (such as Listening Device), the player who assigned the condition may view the flipped dial.

rulings.q: When I perform an attack with Seyn Marana, what is the timing of her ability to spend a {crit} to deal a damage card directly to a ship? Can I spend an {focus} result via Targeting Matrix to throw a strain, then spend a {crit} for Seyn's ability?
a: Seyn Marana happens during the dice mod step; you cannot then use targeting matrix

rulings.q: If you have 2 friendly ships with Tactical Scrambler between you and the attacking ship do you roll two extra defense dice? I know that doesn't work for two obstacles, but this says: “While you obstruct an enemy ship's attack, the defender rolls 1 additional defense die.” And there will be two cases of you.
a: Yes, you'd roll 1 extra for each tactical scrambler obstructing the attack

rulings.q: Does Colonel Jendon's ability work with ST-321 coordinate to acquire lock beyond range 3?
a: You ignore the range restrictions of acquiring a lock but not the restriction that you must choose an enemy ship at r0-3 of the coordinated ship

rulings.q: Can I decide in which order I do what bonus attack? After I shot a missile with Vynder and hit the target. Also does the attack from Ion cannon have to hit for stealth gambit to be viable, when I choose to shoot ion before gambit? Because I added the bonus attack already to the q beforehand...
a: yeah you pick the order to do the bonus attacks
